correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive enumeration for n=1..6 and binary Gaussian elimination yields f(n=6)=(720,6840,15360,12060,4320,720) and boundary ranks (719,6121,8370,3600,720). Hence third reduced F2 Betti 12060-8370-3600=90 and second 15360-6121-8370=869. At n=5 H3 dimension 690-570-120=0, and n<5 likewise zero. Two independent standard-library implementations respectively use graph-square maximal cliques and mod-two column rank versus Kendall inversion distance, direct clique enumeration and mod-two row rank; both were executed successfully. The infinite claim follows because deleting labels is 1-Lipschitz; each six-letter insertion is an isometry; off-diagonal deletion after insertion factors through K_|T∩U| with H3 zero. Their induced compositions are the Kronecker delta, giving a split injection of one 90-dimensional H3 copy for every six-subset for all n≥6. No integral or other-scale extension is claimed.

value.rationale: This gives a sharp threshold for new third mod-two homology in a standard, natural graph-metric family, with 90 independent classes appearing for the first time at six labels, and proves a nontrivial growing topological lower bound 90*binomial(n,6) simultaneously for all n≥6. The vector-space split by deletion/insertion is structural, and yields high-dimensional information far beyond isolated four-letter persistence tables. This is meaningful even without a complete integral homotopy classification.
